follow-up time: Through three consecutive rounds of ovarian stimulation
outcome: Number of developed and biopsied blastocysts
cohort: 60 women (30-42 years old) with poor ovarian reserve (POR) stratified according to the POSEIDON classification groups 3 and 4
finding: While intraovarian PRP injection increased the number of retrieved oocytes, it did not improve the quality of developed blastocysts or pregnancy rates in women with POR.
